families.name: short_extension_filters
families.why_short_only: Suppresses short names that are already too stretched or too close to a mean-reversion pocket.

families.name: followthrough_quality
families.why_short_only: Keeps only shorts that close weakly and have enough downside followthrough to be enterable at the close.

families.name: bottom_risk_suppression
families.why_short_only: Avoids short names where reversal risk is high because the close is too close to a short-term floor.

families.name: event_risk_suppression
families.why_short_only: Excludes names with near-term earnings or rights dates that can distort short entry quality.
families.note: research-fallback: no borrow table was found, so borrow/cost is only proxied by low liquidity.

families.name: trend_alignment
families.why_short_only: Keeps only shorts with aligned daily trend context and slope confirmation.
